title: Thommanum Makkalum
desc: A thief and his family decide to mend their ways and start afresh. Things take an awry turn when they find themselves embroiled in local issues.

title: Kadha Parayumbol
desc: Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.

title: Janatha Garage
desc: When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.

title: Kidaari
desc: Kombaiah Pandian, a village bigwig, falls victim to a brutal stabbing by an enemy. Consequently, his devoted servant Kidari embarks on a mission to unmask the assailant.

title: The Game
desc: Detective Seo Joon-Young teams up with Kim Tae-Pyung to resolve a serial killer case using Tae-Pyung's unique ability to predict a person's death.

title: Ghilli
desc: An aspiring kabaddi player travels to Madurai to participate in a regional match, where he rescues Dhanalakshmi from Muthupandi, a powerful man who wants to marry the girl against her will.
